documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our equipment maintenance team struggles with spreadsheet coordination. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer explicitly states that their equipment maintenance team struggles with spreadsheet coordination and that they want workflow coordination and account reporting. They have requested a discovery meeting to understand their requirements but have not yet approved a budget. The account is currently in the 'qualified' stage with verified consent and ownership.

claims.quote: Our equipment maintenance team struggles with spreadsheet coordination.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your equipment maintenance team is currently struggling with spreadsheet coordination and that you are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting. To better understand your specific needs and how Cedar Systems can support you, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting. This will allow us to explore integration requirements and tailor a solution to your requirements. Please let us know a convenient time for this discussion.
questions: What specific challenges are you facing with your current spreadsheet coordination process?
Are there any specific systems or tools currently in use that you would like to integrate with Cedar Systems?
What are your expectations for the workflow coordination and account reporting features?
uncertainties: No budget has been approved, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
